mainEntity.name: What are the key components of an effective AEO strategy for a local marketing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: An effective AEO strategy involves several key components. Firstly, identifying common local client questions and mapping them to clear, concise answers. This includes optimizing content for featured snippets and 'People Also Ask' sections. Secondly, ensuring robust and consistent local listings, especially Google Business Profile, with accurate and detailed information. Thirdly, structuring website content using schema markup to help search engines understand the context and intent of the information. Finally, creating high-quality, authoritative content that directly addresses user needs and positions the agency as an expert in its local area and niche.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key AEO components include answering local client questions, optimizing local listings, using schema markup, and creating authoritative content for direct answers.
